state.context: Can P8 requires bounded Bun.stdin reads returning immutable bytes or strict UTF-8 text, io::limit_exceeded(int limit), and io::read_failed(str operation). It gives no maximum max_bytes or negative-limit rule. Can int is arbitrary precision; native buffers have finite capacity. Do not invent compatibility or a second runtime. Retain only chunks within the caller limit, compare counts using bigint before narrowing, cancel on overflow and observe cleanup. P8 env reads validate [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*, expose optional absence or required http::credentials_missing, and use a launch-time snapshot; empty strings are present values. Current bearer auth independently rejects empty credentials. No fixtures may perform ambient reads.

policy.instructions: Choose the stdin policy that best preserves the stated contract without fabricating a hidden cap.

criteria.bounded: Reject negative max_bytes with limit_exceeded; allow zero and nonnegative bigint budgets; consume incrementally, reject crossing the budget, and retain native unexpected allocation failures as standard failures.
criteria.cap: Introduce a fixed 64 MiB maximum for all caller budgets and return limit_exceeded for larger arguments.
criteria.eager: Read all native stdin first and compare the finished buffer size to max_bytes.
